question: Can an Attempt-scoped consumer read an arbitrary Session by id?
answer: No. The composed Attempt-scoped service surface is exactly { previewAttempt, hasDshReader }.

measurements.S1-C5_diagnosticReader: the first-party reader remains available to a trusted operator/research adapter; it is not composed onto the Attempt-scoped service
measurements.S1-C6_modelOrPublicExposure: no unrestricted session list or read operation is reachable from the Attempt consumer

authorizationLimitation: A TypeScript interface is not a security boundary. This stage does not claim multi-user authorization; it removes the unrestricted operation from the Attempt-oriented service and leaves raw session reading as an internal operator-only capability.
